MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Nobody but Me Deluxe and Wallflower appeal to me because polished, mellow vocals fit the relaxed listening I want now and connect with my enjoyment of Stages and Under One Sky.",
    "Emerald: Musical Gems Deluxe feels like a natural next choice because its melodic vocal appeal connects with what I enjoyed in Lead With Your Heart and A Musical Affair."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "That's Christmas To Me and Noel fit part of my history, but enjoying Christmas At Downton Abbey does not mean I want seasonal music right now; the Glee Christmas album misses that same current preference.",
    "Joey+Rory Inspired has a plausible connection to my country listening, but that connection matters less today than relaxing vocals. Chain Breaker and The Hurt & The Healer give me no clear reason to expect the sound I currently want.",
    "Eight Classic Albums vol. 2 leaves me unsure what I would hear, so I cannot connect it confidently to the music I enjoy."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing interest rather than something I return to in a seasonal mood.",
    "My country and soundtrack listening seems to have been extended too broadly; those connections alone do not make an album appealing to me today."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent interest in relaxing classical music makes a calm listening experience especially relevant to what I want now.",
    "Across Stages, Under One Sky, Lead With Your Heart and A Musical Affair, expressive, melodic vocals matter more to me right now than simply sharing a country, soundtrack or holiday connection."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in melodic vocals but gave too much weight to past seasonal and country listening when I currently want relaxing music."
}
